direct_inhibition.label_semantics: direct-inhibition pIC50 measured after preincubation without NADPH; credible intervals and fitted standard deviations are measurement metadata
direct_inhibition.soft_threshold_contract: prediction inside fitted 95_percent_credible_interval has zero numerator error; prediction outside contributes distance to nearest interval bound; denominator applies the same rule to the endpoint mean predictor

CYP1A2_pIC50_direct_inhibition.assay_system: recombinant CYP1A2 biochemical fluorescence inhibition assay

CYP2C9_pIC50_direct_inhibition.assay_system: recombinant CYP2C9 biochemical fluorescence inhibition assay

CYP2D6_pIC50_direct_inhibition.assay_system: recombinant CYP2D6 biochemical label-free inhibition assay
CYP2D6_pIC50_direct_inhibition.probe_or_readout: dextromethorphan parent depletion by SCIEX Echo-MS

CYP3A4_pIC50_direct_inhibition.assay_system: recombinant CYP3A4 biochemical fluorescence inhibition assay

time_dependent_inhibition.label_semantics: time-dependent inhibitor when the fitted IC50 shift after NADPH preincubation exceeds two-fold, including the official inferred-positive/assigned-negative rules near the pIC50 floor

CYP2D6_is_TDI.assay_system: paired plus/minus NADPH recombinant CYP2D6 Echo-MS IC50-shift assay

CYP3A4_is_TDI.assay_system: paired plus/minus NADPH recombinant CYP3A4 fluorescence IC50-shift assay

emax.label: Emax relative to positive control in direct and TDI conditions with credible intervals

external_data_policy.supervised_exact: human recombinant same isoform inhibition, explicit IC50 or pIC50, compatible direct/TDI arm, units and relation operators, license and source provenance; sealed identity/near-neighbor contamination firewall required
external_data_policy.bridge_required: same biological target but assay/probe/arm or label differs; source-aware auxiliary task only
external_data_policy.pretraining_only: related CYP activity or weak/uncertain labels; no challenge endpoint loss
external_data_policy.reject: unknown license/source, non-human target without explicit transfer contract, ambiguous units/thresholds, identity conflict, or unsafe overlap
external_data_policy.test_structure_use: sealed contamination filtering and frozen inference only; no model or source selection
